title: AREF-002 evidence packet
description: A single unit of evidence bearing on exactly one proof obligation for exactly one implementation candidate of one EffectClaim. Frozen by specs/AREF-002/evidence_acquisition.md. A packet never instantiates or suppresses a claim; it can only move an obligation state, and only when its admissibility is PROBATIVE.

packet_id.description: Stable identifier for this packet within its claim.

obligation.description: Exactly one obligation. Evidence bearing on two obligations produces two packets sharing an extract.

implementation_candidate_id.description: The implementation candidate this packet pertains to. Packets are never merged across candidates.

derived_from_rule_id.description: Provenance only, for packets produced by the existing sink-rule corpus. Present or absent, this field has no bearing on claim existence and no authority over any obligation.

rule_match_type.description: The matched rule's own match.type, which fixes admissibility for rule-derived packets.

notes.description: Human-readable commentary. Never a substitute for the verbatim extract.

allOf.$comment: Identifier-anchored evidence can never be PROBATIVE (requirement 10; evidence_acquisition.md 5.3).
name_call, sql_execute_pattern and string_pattern rules are text or bare-name anchored and are HYPOTHESIS_ONLY (AREF-002.md 12).
Dependency- and contract-sourced evidence must name the package and its version resolution (AREF-002-D08).

tier.description: Evidence acquisition ladder tier. L8 (ABSTAIN) is a terminal state, not an evidence source, and is therefore not a legal packet tier.

tierOrAbstain.description: A ladder position including the terminal L8 ABSTAIN state, used for highest-tier-reached reporting.

obligation.description: The frozen v1 proof obligation vocabulary. Closed for EXTERNAL_PERSISTENT_STATE_EFFECT.

admissibility.description: PROBATIVE evidence may alone move an obligation to SUPPORTED or REFUTED and may create CONFLICTING. HYPOTHESIS_ONLY evidence may raise a claim's investigation priority and trigger a counter-evidence search, and may never move a state. There is deliberately no third class.

strength.description: Ordinal annotation used for receipt presentation and investigation prioritisation only. Never affects a state transition and never resolves a contradiction.

packetKind.description: The acquisition mechanism that produced the packet.

ruleMatchType.description: Match types present in actenon_scan/rules/default_rules.json. Listed so that rule-derived packet admissibility is machine-checkable.

locator.description: Where the evidence came from, in enough detail to re-read it and re-verify the extract byte for byte.

path.description: Path relative to the scan root, forward-slash separated.

symbol.description: The symbol the evidence concerns, when applicable.

package.description: Package or module identity. Required for L4, L5 and L6 evidence.

version.description: The resolved version, absent only when version_resolution is UNPINNED.

document_pointer.description: A JSON Pointer or equivalent path into a structured contract document.

versionResolution.description: How the pinned version was established, in the order dependency_descent.md 5.2 requires. UNPINNED means source physically present in the tree was read without a resolvable version, and is never substituted by a typical or latest version.

assertion.description: The structured statement the packet makes about its obligation. Structured rather than free text so that contradictions are computable.

detail.description: Mechanism detail, e.g. the transport, driver, statement root or contract operation identifier.

hops.description: Followed descent edges from the call site to this evidence.

extract.description: Verbatim source text the assertion rests on. Must be byte-identical to the located source. Paraphrase, normalisation, reconstruction and unmarked truncation are violations; the R05/R06 fidelity threshold is exactly 1.00.

verbatim.description: Always true. A packet whose extract is not verbatim is not a legal packet.

truncated.description: True when the extract was truncated for size. The locator must still be sufficient to retrieve the whole.

probeOutcome.description: The outcome of a counter-evidence probe from the closed registry in proof_obligations.md section 7. A BLOCKING probe whose outcome is INCOMPLETE forces ABSTAIN; non-execution is never recorded as NOT_FOUND.

packet_ids.description: Packets the probe produced, if any.

stopReason.description: Why acquisition stopped. TIER_UNAVAILABLE and BUDGET_EXHAUSTED are never merged: the first is a property of the analysed repository, the second of our configuration.
